# Akita

> > Akita is a Microsoft Gold Partner IT services company providing managed IT support, cyber security, and cloud solutions to UK businesses.

Akita delivers comprehensive managed IT services across London and the South East, with expertise in Microsoft 365, cyber security compliance, and business continuity. The company combines 24/7 support infrastructure with strategic partnerships and a commitment to sustainable, secure IT operations.

## Key Topics

- Managed IT Services
- 24/7 IT Support
- Cyber Security
- Microsoft 365
- Microsoft Gold Partner
- Cloud Services
- NOC (Network Operations Centre)
- Penetration Testing
- Cyber Essentials
- ISO 27001
- CREST Accredited
- Google Workspace
- Mac Support
- London & South East
- Digital Transformation

## Core Services

- [Business IT Services London, UK - Akita](https://www.akita.co.uk/services): Akita's full range of professional IT services including security and cloud solutions
- [IT Support London, UK - Managed IT Support Services - Akita](https://www.akita.co.uk/services/it-support): Akita's 24/7 managed IT support and proactive monitoring services for London and UK
- [24/7 IT Support Services London, UK - Akita](https://www.akita.co.uk/services/it-support/24-7): Akita's out-of-hours and 24-hour emergency IT support for business continuity
- [Outsourced IT Support Services London, UK from Akita](https://www.akita.co.uk/services/it-support/outsourced): Co-managed and fully outsourced IT support services from Akita across London and UK
- [NOC Services London, UK - Network Operations Centre - Akita](https://www.akita.co.uk/services/it-support/noc-services): Akita's Network Operations Centre monitoring infrastructure, cloud and servers 24/7

## Cyber Security & Compliance

- [Cyber Security Services Company London, UK](https://www.akita.co.uk/services/security): Akita's cyber security services with CREST penetration testing and ISO 27001 consultancy
- [Penetration Testing Services London, UK | CREST Accredited](https://www.akita.co.uk/services/security/penetration-testing): CREST-accredited penetration testing and vulnerability assessment services from Akita
- [Cyber Essentials Certification & Accreditation In London, UK](https://www.akita.co.uk/services/security/cyber-essentials): Akita's accredited Cyber Essentials assessor services and security certification
